verdict.rationale: E2B is built to be driven programmatically. Its first-party docs cover SDK methods for the full sandbox lifecycle: Sandbox.create, runCode, files.list/read/write, commands.run, setTimeout, kill, pause/resume and metrics. They also document an explicit API-key client for multiple keys, teams or self-hosted deployments, and registrable lifecycle webhooks. missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI/REST reference (probes of the common spec paths returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of API usage.
